newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dongfang Hotel to delegate management right.
newsitem.headline: Dongfang Hotel to delegate management right.

text.p: The two major shareholders of Guangzhou Dongfang Hotel Co Ltd plan to delegate the right to manage the hotel to a third company to improve its operations, an official of the biggest shareholder said.

Guangzhou Dongfang Hotel Group and the Guangzhou bureau of the National Administration of State Property (NASP), which have a combined 63.3 percent equity stake in the firm, intend to delegate their right to manage the firm to the state-run Guangzhou Yuexiu Group, the official told the China Securities Bulletin on Thursday.

According to the listed firm's 1996 interim report, at the end of June, Dongfang Hotel Group had 60.75 million legal person shares or 40.91 percent of its total share capital and Guangzhou NASP held 33.24 million state shares, or 22.39 percent.
The spokesman said he expected negotiations on the management rights to be finalised by the end of this year.
Officials of Guangzhou Dongfang Hotel Co declined comment,

The Shenzhen-listed firm said in an interim report that, under Chinese accounting standards, it posted net earnings of 18.27 million yuan in the first half of this year, down from 32.21 million in the same period of 1995. It blamed the lower profits on increased competition in Guangzhou.
